title: Roku (ROKU) and Etsy (ETSY) Deep Dive Analysis
coverage_note: Read every macro, crypto, portfolio and stock-analysis block and image label. Retained distinct horizons and technical mechanisms; excluded incidental biographies and routine position sizes. Source descriptions compressed to preserve comprehensive material coverage.

claims.reason: The proposed peak failed in observed history, but the explicit immune-evasive-variant exclusion became material with Omicron. This is a failed unconditional path with an activated exception, not an unqualified forecasting miss.

evidence.title: Omicron facts and myths
evidence.finding: European cases exceeded 7 m in first January week versus 1 m weekly in September. Omicron can reinfect previously infected people and cause severe disease; lower individual severity does not eliminate population burden.

claims.reason: A general evolutionary tendency cannot be established from one later variant. Transmissibility, immunity and virulence can evolve separately; no specified virus population or time interval is offered.

assessment: This article contains meaningful misses that must remain visible beside successful crypto calls. June CPI exceeded the range; Etsy failed its 20% growth premise; both selected growth stocks lost roughly 60% over five years despite Roku business expansion. BTC beat ETH over the five-year comparison. ETH worked through year-end 2021 but failed over the separate year-ahead horizon. Technical progress in Lightning and Taproot should not be counted as proof of mass payment adoption. The Roku market-cap target is closed by acquisition, with the terminal-event qualification disclosed.
